elaine_sales: Quick sync — prospect wants BYO-KMS POC with an HSM proxy in front of Redwood Private. Key asks: rotation window 15m, attestation artifacts after each ceremony, and 99.9% availability across two AZs. Can infra/SE confirm feasibility and rough incremental cost?
rohit_se: We can support BYO-KMS via an HSM proxy. Main constraints: persistent TLS tunnels to the customer's HSM endpoints, connection keepalive for high qps, and an attestation exchange. For 99.9% across two AZs we should deploy a hot-standby proxy in the second AZ and enable automatic failover.
maria_cloudops: Networking bits — customer must allow outbound to our proxy and to their HSM on TCP 443. Recommend NTP (UDP/123) for HSM time sync. Also we need mutual TLS client certs. Example minimal firewall rules: 
```
- outbound: tcp/443 to hsm.customer.net
- outbound: tcp/443 to proxy.redwood.internal
- outbound: udp/123 to pool.ntp.org
```
nick_security: From the security questionnaire: they want to know rotation cadence, proof-of-deletion, and whether attestations are signed by an HSM CA. We need to provide an attestation template and confirm we can store a signed artifact or hash in audit logs.
elaine_sales: They explicitly asked whether Redwood can emit signed attestations post-rotation, or if the customer must provide them. Any constraints?
rohit_se: For cloud-backed HSMs we can generate and sign attestations using our attestation pipeline if the HSM supports it. For customer-managed on-prem HSMs, typically the customer generates/exports the signed artifact; we can ingest and store its hash. We'll note this in the SOW.
maria_cloudops: Ops note: per-request routing to customer KMS adds ~8–12ms p99 depending on network. If they plan heavy throughput, enable short-lived prefix caching (recommended 30s) to cut external KMS calls for repeated prompt prefixes. That reduces cost and latency.
elaine_sales: Pricing: ballpark incremental for a proxy-enabled POC vs standard hosted? I need a number to put into the presales quote.
rohit_se: Rough estimate: one-time onboarding + SOC/attestation integration ~ $8k engineering fee, monthly proxy capacity for small POC (<=50k tokens/day) ~ $2k/month. HA across AZs + standby adds ~ $1.5k/month. These are pre-sales estimates; will confirm with finance.
nick_security: I'll draft an attestation checklist and a short answer for the questionnaire (fields: what is signed, retention, where the hash is stored, who can access).
elaine_sales: Great. Can we turn a short SOW with clear acceptance criteria and a rotation playbook by EOD tomorrow? I'll schedule the customer call for tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize scope.
